items.author: marek.wrobel
items.title: Ustroń lineup
items.body:
Good evening all. Lineup for the Beskid Junior Team Cup in Ustroń (3-7 December), based on the November rating list:
Board 1 Kacper Nowicki (2010)
Board 2 Igor Sadowski (1874)
Board 3 Maja Krawiec (1860)
Board 4 Antoni Lis (1855)
Reserve Liliana Bąk (1851)
I have to submit names to the organisers on Friday 13 November. Thanks, Marek

items.author: rafael.ortiz
items.body: Makes sense to me. Igor has been very steady this autumn, he will be fine on 2.

items.author: marek.wrobel
items.title: Selection criteria for Ustroń
items.body: For the team event in December we will look at two things: the November FIDE list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier on 24 October. Coaches of the players will be consulted before the final lineup. Marek

items.author: joanna.kurek
items.title: Rapid qualifier 24.10 - final standings
items.body: Rapid qualifier, 7 rounds, 15+10. 1. Kacper Nowicki 6/7, 2. Liliana Bąk 5.5/7 (beat Maja and Antoni, draw with Kacper), 3. Maja Krawiec 4.5/7, 4. Igor Sadowski 4/7, 5. Antoni Lis 4/7, 6. Zuzanna Pietrzak 3.5/7. Full crosstable in the drive.

items.author: joanna.kurek
items.title: November FIDE list
items.body: New FIDE ratings are out. Our juniors: Kacper Nowicki 2010 (+8), Liliana Bąk 1851 (-81), Igor Sadowski 1874 (+12), Maja Krawiec 1860 (+5), Antoni Lis 1855 (+21). Note Liliana's change is from the Katowice open in early October only.

items.author: ewa.bak
items.body: Pani Oksano, the doctor confirmed it is mononucleosis, she was already sick in Katowice and played with fever. She is very embarrassed, please don't tell the other coaches or kids what it is exactly. She is back to school on 19th. Ewa

items.author: joanna.kurek
items.title: Bus to Ustroń
items.body: Bus leaves from the academy on 3 December at 7:30. Parents please confirm seats by 20 November. Price 120 zł return.

items.author: marek.wrobel
items.body: Reminder: October lesson hours to Joanna by Monday please, otherwise invoices will be late again.

items.author: rafael.ortiz
items.body: Hi Oksana, can you take my Saturday beginners on 14th? I have a wedding in Valencia. I can do your Wednesday group in exchange.

items.author: joanna.kurek
items.body: Who left the demo board in the small room with the Najdorf still on it? Cleaning lady thinks it is art now.
